name: HUD frame overlay

source.description: Six inspected references keep a constant frame layer over changing scenes: corner brackets and micro labels, an engineering-drawing border, life-stat counters or a chapter progress bar.

technique: A thin, persistent frame (corner marks, tiny labels, a counter, a progress rule) sits above every scene and survives every cut. It turns a sequence of disparate shots into one designed object and gives the viewer a sense of place and progress.
purpose: Continuity across hard cuts; editorial polish; progress and context (section, counter, credit).
visual_behaviour: Four corner brackets or a ruled border at the safe area; small uppercase labels in the corners; one label updates (counter, chapter, age); a rule fills along the bottom.
mechanics: Static layer above transitions; label swaps of 0.15-0.3 s; progress linear with time.

decomposition.timing: Constant for the whole piece; counter swaps on cuts.

failure_modes: Labels below the text floor are unreadable on phones
HUD colour that does not adapt to dark and light scenes disappears
Corner labels colliding with scene text in portrait

implementation.approach: Studio.comp.frameHud: brackets and labels pinned to the safe-area corners above the transition overlay; set() swaps a label at a cue; progress() fills the rule. Colour switches should be chained (each from the previous value) for seek safety.

measurements.what: every-frame preview capture of tests/reference-derived/word-beats (HUD over every frame), 1280x720, 375 frames
measurements.value: 47.0 ms/frame median, peak headless Chromium 291 MB

capability.native_option: DOM layer with GSAP label swaps.
limitations: Labels are kept at the 2.6% text floor, larger than the micro labels seen in the references

provenance.observed: Corner brackets and tiny corner labels persist over every scene and transition.
Same kind of persistent corner frame over dark, light and colour scenes.
Both halves keep small corner meta text over every card.
An engineering-drawing border with a title block frames the type compositions.
Age and heart-rate counters in the top corners update from scene to scene.
A chapter progress bar and caption block stay on screen while the 3D scene changes.

evidence.notes: Label swap, progress tracks time, stays above a bloom.
Corner labels count the folds (Fold n / 4, then Flight); the HUD colour follows each background, chained from the previous colour. Frame review 0 errors, 0 warnings (preview grade).

licensing_notes: Technique only, learned from user-supplied references (inspiration-only, rights unknown). Labels and layout are original.
